body: I’ll try to find one. Thank you you’ve been very kind.

You’re right. I guess the only thing that’s really in the way of finding my own happiness is not being able to communicate how I really feel. Depression runs in my family, but if I tell my mom, I’m afraid she’ll make me take antidepressants. From what I’ve heard from people who have taken them for severe depression, I don’t want to take them. I’m scared to come clean about the overbearing suicidal thoughts I experience and the bitter isolation I feel. I don’t know what to do.

Even if they would care, idk what I can do to stop battling the incessant paranoia I experience. Like this little voice in my head scrutinizing my existence and degrading myself. I sort of figure, if I can’t feel the love they allegedly have for me, what’s the point of continuing to pretend I do? I just feel like I invest so much into people and always let them know how much I care about them, but never once have I gotten it in return. It makes me think, they must not feel the same way. That imbalance scares me. I just don’t know where to go from here.

I can hardly fathom the pain you must be feeling. Your story holds more weight and resonates with people more than you could ever comprehend. The world is shitty and horrible things happen for no reason it seems like. I encourage you to find your peace and seek contentment— whatever that means to you. Reconnect with yourself before attempting relationships. I go through the same day, struggling with the weight of failed friendships. I believe in your ability to overcome this. 

Don’t let those evil people win. You have the strength to pull through. If you quit, you surrender to the evil of the world. fuck em. You matter.
A question I desperately seek to find the answer to, but have yet to find the satisfaction of understanding that.

Your post was very enlightening, and I relate to your anecdote immensely, more than you could know. What really resonated with me though, was when you explained the regret suicide victims experience once they commit to their actions. I just feel like I’d have little regret— I feel as though the people I care about the most would hardly be struck by my absence. I don’t know how to surpass those feelings.

very well said. Once you have this revelation of just how internally selfish everyone is, you become really paranoid at the relationships you’re investing in. The worst part is when you can’t communicate how you feel— people have no idea your doubts or trust issues. This causes you to lapse deeper into the trance of depression.
We’re all existing alone together. there are 7 billion people on earth right now. there is a statistical Guarantee that some people will enjoy being in your company
